buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility & Proven Performance Requirement The Railway reserves the right to procure the item only from the original manufacturer or their authorized agent/distributor having proven past performance. Bidders must have executed at least 20% same or simil ar in a single contract with any Government organization in the last three years as of the bid opening date. Documentary evidence must be submitted with the offer, including copies of recent Purchase Orders, Receipt Notes, GeM Contracts, and CRAC/CRAN. Non-submission of such documents will be considered as no past performance, and such offers will be summarily rejected. No representation will be entertained int his regard. 2. Bid Authorization Requirement Only manufacturers or their authorized distributors/dealers/agents with bid-specific authorization are eligib le to quote. OEMs may authorize their agents to quote on their behalf through a Bid-Specific Authorization Letter, provided that: The manufacturer accepts full responsibility for product quality and warranty obligations. Inspection and dispatch must take place at the manufacturer's premises. Offers without a Bid-Specific Auth orization Letter (if not submitted by the OEM directly) will be summarily rejected. 3. Verification of Authorization Bidders must provide contact details (email ID and phone number) of the authorization letter issuing autho rity, along with the head office email, to verify the authenticity of the authorization. 4. Inspection & Dispatch Location Materials must be inspected as per Coveragae PO and dispatched strictly from the OEM's premises. Any de viation will result in summary rejection of the offer.

5. Inspection Clause Offers with conditional inspection will be summarily rejected. No representation will be entertained in such cases. 6. Bidder's Undertaking The bidder must submit an undertaking on their letterhead, duly signed and sealed, confirming execution of the order as per buyer specifications. The undertaking must state: "Our offer against GeM Bid No. ____________ does not contain any deviation from the stipulated bid conditio ns, and we accept all the terms and conditions of the bid document without any deviations." Incomplete or non-submission of this undertaking will lead to summary rejection of the offer. No further cor respondence will be entertained. 6. Unit of Measurement The buying unit is in Kgs. Bidders must quote prices accordingly. 7. Firm Status Validity The status of the firm will be considered as on the date of bid opening. Any changes thereafter will not be considered, except in the case of removal/suspension/banning. 8. Delivery Schedule Time is the essence of the contract. Bidders must quote delivery schedules strictly in line with the bid docu ment. Vague or broad timelines (e.g., “2–28 weeks” or “3–8 months”) or unreasonably long periods may b e treated as commercially unresponsive, and such offers are liable to be ignored. 9. EMD Requirement Bidders must submit EMD as per the Railway Board guidelines. Offers without EMD will be summarily reject ed, unless the bidder is exempted under the latest Ministry guidelines on public procurement. 11. Delivery Undertaking Firms must provide an undertaking on their letterhead to execute the order within 30 days. Non submissio n of this undertaking will lead to summary rejection. No further correspondence in this regard will be enter tained. 12. Applicable Terms IRS (Indian Railway Standard) terms and conditions shall apply to this tender. 13. EMD PAYMENT: Due to a technical issue on GeM, the EMD option is not available while creating the bid. Therefore, bidders shall be required to deposit EMD amounting to approximately Rs. 99,000/-, in favour of PFA/MLG. Failure t o deposit the EMD shall result in summary rejection of the bid. EMD exemption, wherever applicable, shallb e governed by the relevant Railway Board circulars Document must be uploaded for claim of EMD exempti om. . 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): TPI Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: NA
